intent: Thermal Throttling and BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) issues with Intel Core i9-14900HX
detected_fault: Thermal throttling, BSOD due to insufficient cooling system
suggested_solution: Clean the laptop's cooling system and reapply thermal paste with Honeywell PTM 7950.
Set all Turbo Groups to a consistent value (48).
Use the Windows High Performance power plan.
Access the MSI advanced BIOS settings by pressing Right Shift + Copilot Key + Left ALT + F2 function key.
Try setting IMON Slope to 50 in the BIOS.
Uninstall MSI Center and retest to see if it makes any difference.
